signature.one_line: Editorial podcast layout: top-left word build, giant accent key phrases, rounded footage card.
unique_devices: Top-left editorial text block that accumulates 1-4 left-aligned lines; only the NEXT word is previewed in light grey and each word lands dark with a 1-frame horizontal motion blur
One key phrase per sentence in giant accent extra-bold (~2.5x body) ending in a full stop, stacked under the dark lines on the same left edge
Podcast footage shrunk into a rounded, soft-shadowed card in the lower half of an off-white canvas; spoken numbers become a big-numeral stat list that replaces the card
All transitions are layout crossfades; ends on a text-only frame that repeats the hook phrase (loop-back)
signature.why_it_works: A coined term and an open loop hook, then a print-magazine layout makes a plain podcast clip feel designed; the word build supplies motion without cuts.

hook.first_frame: Off-white canvas; podcast guest in profile inside a rounded card in the lower half; first dark words building top-left with the next word in light grey

structure.what: open loop builds top-left; the coined key phrase lands in giant accent
black insert of a web page under the running caption (now white)
mechanics explained; host reaction in the card
big-numeral stat list replaces the card; accent one-word key phrase
list completes with a accent total; black insert with stat tiles; origin aside
closing line, then a text-only end frame repeating the hook phrase

pacing.pace: moderate cuts, but the frame changes every ~0.3-0.5 s through the word build

captions.what: editorial build block, dark grey with next-word grey preview
captions.how: left edge 7.6 % W, first line centre ~17.4 % H (hook), line pitch 5.2 % H, max width 78 % W, 2-4 words per line, up to 4 lines; Inter 600 80 px; next word appears light grey, lands dark with a 1-frame horizontal blur sliding ~2 % W from the right; block clears at layout change

captions.what: giant accent key phrase with a full stop
captions.how: Inter 800 166 px (smaller when sharing the top with the card), tracking -0.04em, stacked under the dark lines, same left edge; lands with the same 1-2 frame blur ~4 frames before its word

background_text.how: off-white; dark lead line at 36 % H, accent two-line key phrase at 39.5-58 % H, left 8 %

motion_graphics.how: rows of number + label: earlier rows mid-grey, the new total accent bold with a thin dark rule above; numbers ~5 % H at x 7.5 %, labels at x ~22 %; replaces the footage card for ~3 s

cards_lists.what: stat tiles on black web inserts
cards_lists.how: black screen with a web page (serif heading with an italic accent word) and number tiles; running caption turns white at the top

layout.what: rounded footage card on off-white canvas
layout.how: card x 7.5-92.5 %, y 45-93 %, radius ~24 px @1080, soft drop shadow; text area top-left 10-35 % H

camera.how: guest MCU profile, occasional host reaction; no punch-ins

transitions.how: soft crossfade ~8-12 frames between layouts (card / list / insert / end frame)

end_card.how: repeats the hook key phrase in accent

case.caption: lowercase as spoken (sentence case after a full stop)
case.key: lowercase or sentence case, always ending with a full stop

captions_spec.punctuation: none in running lines; a full stop on every magenta key phrase

grouping.sync: word-by-word build; the next word is previewed in light grey and turns dark on its spoken word
grouping.break: the block clears (crossfade/cut) when the layout changes or after ~2-4 lines

layout.footage_card: footage in a rounded card x 7.5-92.5 %, y 45-93 % (radius ~24 px @1080, soft drop shadow) under the text
layout.key_phrase: magenta lines stack directly under the dark lines, same left edge
layout.end_frame: text only: lead line at 36 % H, two-line key phrase at 39.5-58 % H, left 8 %

caption.letterform_evidence: Inter: double-storey a, flat-topped t, single-storey g with open hook, straight-tailed y, tight apertures
caption.calibration_note: dark text on off-white (clean); a second 3-word lowercase line without ascender-descender extremes measured 3.2 % H / 63.5 % W at the same size
caption.color: spoken #2F2E2C (dark grey); upcoming word #CECBC7 (light grey); on black inserts the running line is white

key.letterform_evidence: same Inter shapes at a heavy weight, tight tracking
key.calibration_note: a 9-letter lowercase word on the end frame measured 6.88 % H / 65.7 % W (clean; word withheld). In the hook the key phrase is smaller (~44 % W for the same word, estimated) because it shares the top with the footage card.

animation.word_build: the next word appears early in light grey #CECBC7 (preview), then on its spoken word it lands in dark grey with a 1-frame horizontal motion blur (slides ~2 % W from the right), within ~1 frame of the word start
animation.key_entry: magenta line lands with the same 1-2 frame blur-in, ~4 frames before its word
animation.line_wrap: new line starts under the previous at a ~5.2 % H pitch
animation.exit: soft crossfade to the next layout (all transitions are crossfades)

other_text_spec.text: rows of a big number + label: earlier rows mid-grey (~#9A9A9A), the new total in magenta #C34479 bold with a dark label 'Label in total.', a thin dark rule above the total; numbers ~5 % H at x 7.5 %, labels at x ~22 % (estimated)
black screen with a web page (serif heading with an orange / teal italic accent word, stat tiles with large numbers); the running caption turns white at the top
no text; rounded card with soft shadow
text only on off-white: dark 'lead words' + magenta two-line 'KEY / WORD.'

style.look_intent: off-white editorial canvas, high-contrast dark type, muted warm beige studio footage with natural skin, one raspberry accent

sound.music: possible very low music bed (gaps ~21 dB below speech); voice-led compressed mix
sfx: none needed: no hard cuts (single take)
optional soft tick on each magenta key phrase (inferred)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: Podcast or interview footage that looks plain and needs a designed, editorial feel
The argument centres on one coined term or key phrase that can recur
The speech contains several numbers that can become a stat list
The brand wants a calm, premium, print-magazine aesthetic instead of loud captions
avoid_when: Solo talking-head where the face should fill the frame (the card shrinks the speaker)
Fast hype edits that need hard cuts and punch-ins
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B47 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B47.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. Off-white editorial canvas; footage lives in a card.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} >= 7:1 on {{SURFACE}}; {{ACCENT}} >= 4.5:1 on {{SURFACE}}; the preview grey {{ACCENT_2}} must read clearly lighter than {{TEXT}})
- {{TEXT}}: default #2F2E2C (running lines)
- {{ACCENT}}: default #C34479 (giant key phrases, list totals)
- {{ACCENT_2}}: default #CECBC7 (next-word preview grey)
- {{SURFACE}}: default #F3F1ED (off-white canvas)
- {{CARD_BG}}: default #000000 (proof inserts; running line turns white there)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Inter 800 (key phrases)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Inter 600 (running lines)
- {{HANDLE}}: not on screen
- {{LOGO}}: optional, only inside the web-page proof inserts

CAPTIONS (editorial build)
1. Latin, as spoken, lowercase (sentence case after a full stop); no punctuation in running lines; no emoji.
2. Left-aligned block, left edge 7.6 % W, first line centre ~17.4 % H, line pitch 5.2 % H, max width 78 % W; 2-4 words per line, up to 4 lines; the block clears at each layout change.
3. {{FONT_BODY}} at 80 px, tracking -0.02em, no stroke/shadow/box. The NEXT word appears early in {{ACCENT_2}}; on its spoken word it turns {{TEXT}} and lands with a 1-frame horizontal motion blur sliding ~2 % W from the right.
4. One key phrase per ~8-10 s in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 166 px (smaller when sharing the top with the card), {{ACCENT}}, tracking -0.04em, always ending with a full stop, stacked directly under the dark lines on the same left edge; lands ~4 frames before its word with the same blur.
5. On {{CARD_BG}} inserts the running line turns white.

LAYOUT AND EDIT DEVICES
6. Footage in a rounded card x 7.5-92.5 %, y 45-93 %, radius ~24 px, soft drop shadow, on {{SURFACE}}.
7. Spoken numbers -> stat list replacing the card for ~3 s: rows of a big number (~5 % H) at x 7.5 % + label at x ~22 %; earlier rows mid-grey, the new total in {{ACCENT}} bold with a thin dark rule above it.
8. Proof inserts (~3-4 s): {{CARD_BG}} screen with the brand's web page / stat tiles under the running caption.
9. Every transition is a soft layout crossfade (~8-12 frames); no hard cuts, no punch-ins.
10. End on a text-only frame on {{SURFACE}}: lead line at 36 % H, the hook's KEY WORD phrase in {{ACCENT}} at 39.5-58 % H, left 8 %.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: muted warm studio footage with natural skin under a clean off-white, high-contrast editorial frame.
SOUND: voice-led and compressed; any bed at least ~20 dB under speech; -14 LUFS.

VERIFY
a) Render the running line "it's always been" at 80 px on {{SURFACE}} and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test_render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.05,0.14,0.9,0.21 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60"   (default ink #2F2E2C)
   Required: 3.91 % ±0.5 of H, 50.0 % ±2 of W.
b) Key phrase: render "KEY WORD." in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 166 px with --ink "{{ACCENT}}:70"; expected ink from video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "{{FONT_DISPLAY}}" --word <word> (a 9-letter lowercase word should be ~6.9 % H, ~66 % W).
c) If {{FONT_BODY}} is not Inter 600, re-solve with fit_font.py --font "{{FONT_BODY}}" --word "it's always been" --ink 3.91 --width 50.0 --tracking -0.02.
